Abolished by 법률 제4541호 (promulgated and in force 1993-03-06, 제37조의2 삭제) and 대통령령 제13870호 상공자원부와그소속기관직제 부칙 제2조 (동력자원부와그소속기관직제 폐지), merged into 상공자원부 (industry lineage). spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25, a caretaker holdover with one day in the window. Named in the 1986-01-07 개각, announced that afternoon (the outgoing ministers' resignations were accepted the same day, 경향신문 1986-01-07), and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1986-01-08, the day of his 취임식. The start follows the 임명장 day, which the motir page and ko.wikipedia also print. It is medium because the announcement came the day before (see issues). He left with the whole 김정렬 cabinet. 노태우 accepted its collective resignations on the morning of 1988-02-25 and gave the new cabinet, with 이봉서 at 동력자원부, the 임명장 the same morning, so the handover is same-day. ko.wikipedia gives 1988-02-24 as the last day. spells.notes: First 노태우 cabinet. Promoted from 동력자원부 차관, named by the president-elect on 1988-02-19 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1988-02-25 right after the inauguration. Retained in the 1988-12-05 전면개각, in which 동자부 was one of four ministries whose head stayed (see continuity), so there is no new spell at that date. The whole cabinet handed in resignations on 1990-03-16, and the 3·17 개각 announced 이희일 as his successor on the morning of Saturday 1990-03-17. The new ministers received the 임명장 on the morning of Monday 1990-03-19. No dated acceptance of his own resignation and no dated 이임식 were found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor, same-day handover). If the announcement took legal effect, the end would be 1990-03-17 with a vacancy on 03-18 (see issues). He was later 상공부장관 from 1990-12-27 (동아일보 1990-12-27 '전임李鳳瑞장관이 상공부장관으로 발탁'), which belongs to the industry lineage. Birth date 1936-02-24 from ko.wikipedia '이봉서' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920775 (revid 41920775, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T10:00:08-0400, snapshot roster/sources/energy/ext88/persons/kowiki_이봉서.json) and Wikidata Q16090891 (Wikidata SPARQL (secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T10:00:10-0400, snapshot roster/sources/energy/ext88/persons/wikidata_persons.json)). spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of Sunday 1991-05-26 in the reshuffle that followed 정원식's appointment as 국무총리서리, and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27 with 취임식 at 16:00 that day. The start follows the 임명장 day (medium, see issues). Retained through the 1991-12-19, 1992-03-30, 1992-06-25 and 1992-10-09 reshuffles (see continuity). Last 동력자원부장관. He stayed past the 1993-02-25 inauguration of 김영삼. The 이임식 was first planned for the afternoon of 02-25 and then held on the morning of 1993-02-26, the day the first 김영삼 cabinet was named and received the 임명장 (14:00). The new cabinet had no 동력자원부장관, because the 정부조직법 amendment merging the ministry into 상공자원부 had passed the Assembly. 총무처 treated him as 의원면직 and ruled that the 차관 would act until the amendment took effect (매일경제 1993-02-27). end_reason is 'resigned' because he left by 의원면직 while the office still existed. issues.desc: Start-date convention for reshuffles announced before the 임명장. Pre-2001 there is no gazette file. This file starts each spell on the 임명장 day, which is also the day the motir 역대 장관 page (tier 2) prints for every holder here, and ends a replaced minister on the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor) when no dated acceptance was found. Split cases, announcement -> 임명장: 최창락 1986-01-07 -> 01-08, 이희일 1990-03-17 -> 03-19, 진념 1991-05-26 -> 05-27, each with start_confidence 'medium' and the announcement day as nomination_date. The same rule is used in agriculture, finance, interior, justice, general_affairs and science ext88 files. epb.ext88.json instead ends 조순 on 1990-03-17, so the 1990-03-17/19 reshuffle is handled differently across lineages. If the announcement day were the legal date, 이봉서 would end on 1990-03-17 (the cabinet had resigned en bloc on 1990-03-16, 세계일보 1990-03-17) with 1990-03-18 vacant, and 이희일 would end on 1991-05-26. industry.ext88.partial.json ends 한승수 (상공부) on 1990-03-17 because his 퇴임식 is dated that morning (동아일보 1990-03-17 p.2). A rerun search on 2026-09-26 (9 News Library and BigKinds queries for 동자부 이임식, 이봉서 이임식/퇴임 in 1990-03-16..22 and 이희일 이임식/귀국 in 1991-05-26..06-10, roster/sources/energy/ext88/handover_check.json, snapshots roster/sources/energy/ext88/nl_search/hc_*.json and roster/sources/energy/ext88/bk_search/hc_*.json, accessed 2026-09-26T12:49:20-0400 to 12:49:50-0400) found no dated 이임식 or 퇴임 for 이봉서. 이희일 was still abroad on 1991-05-28 (조선일보 1991-05-28 p.2 '過客장관', article 1991052800239102005, search snippet '李熺逸(이희일)전장관이 아직 해외출장에서귀국하지 않은 동자부도'), so no dated exit before the successor's 임명장 was found for him. Both ends stay inferred_from_successor.
